content.text:
Command: cd /workspace/project && cat -A split_lines.sh && ./split_lines.sh $'a\nb\nc' && bash -n split_lines.sh && echo SYNTAX_OK
Read-only: false
Sandbox: disabled
Exit code: 0

STDOUT:
#!/usr/bin/env bash$
# split_lines.sh: print every field of the first argument on its own line$
IFS=$'\n'$
read -r -a parts <<< "$1"$
for p in "${parts[@]}"; do$
  echo "[$p]"$
done$
[a]
SYNTAX_OK
